name: scraper_project
description: This folder contains the tooling that collects product reviews, walks through pagination, and saves the results in JSONL/CSV form for later analysis. The project includes a tiny synthetic catalogue so the pipeline can be exercised without touching the network, plus CLI switches for real-world runs.

scripts.scrape_help:
node -e "console.log('Available commands:

NPM scripts:
- npm run scrape_product
  Collect product IDs from category URLs in categories.txt

- npm run scrape_review_def
  Collect reviews with default concurrency 3

- npm run scrape_review_4
  Collect reviews with concurrency 4

- npm run scrape_review_5
  Collect reviews with concurrency 5

- npm run previous_scrapes
  List previous incomplete review runs

- npm run all_scrapes
  List all review runs, including completed ones

- npm run failed_scrapes
  Retry failed jobs from the latest failed list

- npm run failed_scrapes_4
  Retry failed jobs with concurrency 4

- npm run resume_help
  Show resume-run examples

- npm run failed_help
  Show failed-run examples

- npm run named_run_help
  Show named-run examples

Direct commands:
- node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=<runName>
  Start a new named run
  Example: node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=agiz-dis-bakimi

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=<runId>
  Resume a previous run using the same run ID

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only
  Retry failed jobs from the latest failed list

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only --name=<runName>
  Start or continue a named failed-only run

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --categories=<slug1,slug2>
  Run only selected categories

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --products=<id1,id2>
  Run only selected product IDs

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --concurrency=<n>
  Override worker count

- node collection_auto_rawData.js --list-all-runs
  List all review runs, including completed ones

- You can combine filters
  Example: node collection_auto_rawData.js --name=mobilya-test --categories=mobilya --products=734699208,734700038 --concurrency=4

- Resume with a different concurrency
  Example: node collection_auto_rawData.js --resume-run=mobilya-test --concurrency=4

- Resume only failed jobs from a specific file
  Example: node collection_auto_rawData.js --failed-only --failed-file=logs/failed_jobs_latest.json')"
